questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a declaration file?
options: It describes the types of existing JavaScript APIs without providing their runtime implementation.
It replaces the runtime JavaScript implementation.
It proves a package is secure.
questions.answer_key: It describes the types of existing JavaScript APIs without providing their runtime implementation.
questions.explanation: Declaration files describe APIs and should be tested against real consumers and supported versions.

questions.prompt: Which statement is correct about “Global Augmentation”?
options: The safest approach is to skip diagnostics and trust the first output.
A type assertion automatically validates every value at runtime.
The learner should publish hidden solutions so the exercise can grade itself.
The concept should be demonstrated with extending global interfaces and checked against its intended contract.
questions.answer_key: The concept should be demonstrated with extending global interfaces and checked against its intended contract.
questions.explanation: The supplied syllabus explicitly includes “Extending global interfaces”; connect it to a concrete example and verify the behavior relevant to this lesson.

questions.prompt: What is a good verification step after practicing “Global Augmentation”?
options: Ignore compiler or test failures if the interface looks correct.
Treat passing a static token check as proof that the program executed correctly.
Check environment-specific declarations, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
Assume avoiding accidental global conflicts is unnecessary because the code has type annotations.
questions.answer_key: Check environment-specific declarations, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
questions.explanation: The syllabus includes “Environment-specific declarations”. Verification should match the concept: type-level checks, runtime tests, configuration checks or human review as appropriate.
